Flow.description:
Three scheduled paths anchored to the SLA target fields written by AF_FL_Lead_OwnerAssignment_SLA. Each path re-checks whether the threshold was actually breached (the target field may have been superseded by real contact/disposition activity) before creating an escalation Task.
ENHANCED 2026-08-16: Added comprehensive error handling and validation to prevent flow failures that could block lead conversion: - Added validation decisions (Has_Valid_Owner_15Min, Has_Valid_Manager_1Hr, Has_Valid_Manager_3Day) to check if owner exists before task creation - Added fault paths to all task creation elements (Create_FirstContact_Reminder, Create_Agent_Escalation_1Hr, Create_Manager_Escalation_3Day) with error logging - Added error logging via AF_IntegrationLastError__c field for troubleshooting - Implemented graceful degradation: skips task creation if owner unavailable instead of failing - Fixed INVALID_CROSS_REFERENCE_KEY errors when lead owner is a queue or user has no manager - Flow continues to update SLA status even when task creation fails, preventing record locks
CONFIRMED AS CULPRIT 2026-08-16: This flow was confirmed as the cause of the RECORD_IN_USE_BY_WORKFLOW error during lead conversion. When disabled, lead conversion works. When enabled, it fails. The root cause is that scheduled paths in record-triggered flows are scheduled at trigger time and execute later, even if the record is converted in the meantime. Final fix: Changed trigger type from CreateAndUpdate to Create only, so the flow only runs on lead creation and never during updates (including lead conversion). This prevents scheduled paths from being created during conversion entirely.
KNOWN SIMPLIFICATION: notifications are Tasks assigned to the Owner (15-min tier) and to the Owner's Manager via the standard User.ManagerId hierarchy (1-hour and 3-day tiers), not a Custom Notification, and not the Salesforce Role-based CRM Supervisor/Manager the LLD specifies (role-based resolution needs a Get Records against the role hierarchy this flow does not yet implement).
FIXED 2026-08-16: Added decision elements (Check_Not_Converted_15Min, Check_Not_Converted_1Hr, Check_Not_Converted_3Day) within each scheduled path to verify the lead is still not converted before executing escalation logic. This prevents scheduled paths from attempting to update already-converted leads, which was causing "Unable to convert lead that is in use by workflow" errors during lead conversion. The entry criteria also has IsConverted = false filter as a first line of defense.

formulas.name: EmailBody_15Min
formulas.expression: "This Lead has not been contacted within 15 minutes of assignment." & BR() & BR() & "Lead: " & {!$Record.Name} & BR() & "Company: " & {!$Record.Company} & BR() & "Phone: " & {!$Record.Phone} & BR() & "Status: " & TEXT({!$Record.Status})

formulas.name: EmailBody_1Hr
formulas.expression: "This Lead has not been contacted within 1 hour of assignment. The SLA is now breached." & BR() & BR() & "Lead: " & {!$Record.Name} & BR() & "Company: " & {!$Record.Company} & BR() & "Phone: " & {!$Record.Phone} & BR() & "Status: " & TEXT({!$Record.Status})

formulas.name: EmailBody_3Day
formulas.expression: "This Lead has not reached a final disposition within 3 working days of assignment." & BR() & BR() & "Lead: " & {!$Record.Name} & BR() & "Company: " & {!$Record.Company} & BR() & "Phone: " & {!$Record.Phone} & BR() & "Status: " & TEXT({!$Record.Status})
